aboutCompany.title: A 3-Generation Family Enterprise Delivering Excellence
aboutCompany.paragraph1: Starting fresh produce cultivation in 1945, our company has steadily expanded production capacity and quality over more than 70 years, thriving as a third-generation family business.
aboutCompany.paragraph2: Building upon our domestic reputation in the 1980s, Meypal expanded exports across the Middle East and Balkans, moving into Russia and European markets in the 1990s. Since the early 2000s, our seasoned team has managed year-round export operations sourced from premier agricultural regions across Turkey.
